name: ProcIndex
long_description:
ProcIndex gives construction and manufacturing finance teams an AI accounting team that works inside the ERP they already run, including CMiC, Sage 100 Contractor, Sage 300 CRE, Trimble Viewpoint Vista, Sage Intacct, NetSuite, QuickBooks, SAP, Oracle and Microsoft Dynamics. No migration, nothing new to learn.

Agents run accounts payable, accounts receivable, vendor management, reconciliation and month-end close end to end: invoices captured from any inbox, portal or job-site photo, coded to jobs and cost codes, lien-waiver checked and posted; collections and same-day cash application; instant payment-status answers for suppliers; books reconciled all month so close is calm.

98.1% of invoices are processed without human intervention, with a full audit trail on every action.
one_liner: AI accounting team for construction and manufacturing, in any ERP
